blocks.text: The firewall can be enabled on a per-location basis.
Before enabling the firewall, ensure the following prerequisites are met:

blocks.item: Ensure you have configured the following policy resources:
Users, Groups, Departments, Locations, and Sublocations for your Firewall policies
Network Applications. You can create network application groups as needed.
Network Services. You can modify network services to edit services, add custom services, and create groups.
Source and Destination IPv4 Address Groups
Ensure you have defined the necessary rules for each policy:
If your organization uses non-standard ports for HTTP, HTTPS, DNS, FTP, RTSP, or PPTP traffic, ensure you have configured the service to use custom ports for these services.

blocks.heading: Enabling the Firewall for a Location

blocks.text: To enable the firewall for a location:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Location Management > Legacy Locations.
In the Locations tab on the Location Management page, click the Edit icon next to the location you want to enable.
Select Enforce Firewall Control to enable the service's firewall controls.
Select Enable IPS Control to enable the service's IPS controls. (Available with Advanced Firewall)
Click Save and activate the change.
